name: sense_enemy_facing_me
about: Whether the enemy faces the NPC is the enemy's own cone (6b, 0019/4). GatherEnemyConditions 0x10270b20 step 7 (conditions-and-states.md): under SEE_ENEMY it asks the enemy's combat character (+0x9c) slot 363 FInViewCone on this NPC -- true sets ENEMY_FACING_ME 0x56 and clears BEHIND_ENEMY 0x57, false the reverse; both are cleared at the top of every gather. The player is a CBaseCombatCharacter whose slot 363 is the base 0x10326750 -> FinViewCone3dNew 0x103264d0 with the player's m_flFieldOfView 0.5 (senses.md 'Cone'). Guard at (384, -393.7) Source units facing +Y, D_HT 5, npc_perception 3; the standing player 300 units straight ahead, facing the guard (dot 1.0 > 0.5): every gather that sees him raises ENEMY_FACING_ME and never BEHIND_ENEMY.
known_red: 3: BEHIND_ENEMY 0x57 is raised on every gather and ENEMY_FACING_ME never -- the player's slot 363 FInViewCone(entity) answers false
